verdict_word: Revenue missed big, cash pile huge
takeaways: Q3 revenue was $1.411 million versus $1.947 million a year earlier; nine-month revenue was $10.9 million versus $5.2 million, about 110% growth (company release).
Operating loss widened to $33.2 million from $20.5 million; GAAP net loss was only $3.1 million thanks to a $25.3 million gain on warrant liabilities (10-Q via StockTitan).
Cash, equivalents and investments were $497.1 million with no debt.
Cepheus-1-108Q hit 99.5% median two-qubit gate fidelity, and the company signed a definitive $100 million agreement with the U.S. Department of Commerce.
The roughly $20 million full-year revenue outlook depends on customer acceptance of the C-DAC system and revenue recognition in Q4.
verdict: Rigetti's quarter was tiny, with revenue under $1.5 million, while the balance sheet is anything but. The full-year target needs one big customer sign-off in Q4, so everyone is now hoping C-DAC reads its acceptance email.

sources.title: Rigetti Computing Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results (GlobeNewswire)
